mission: Fix Proto A Rate Limiter + Implement Bus Compaction

task_1_diagnosis.summary: Diagnosed root cause of 64.6% denial rate
task_1_diagnosis.root_cause: The rate limiter in state.py (SharedState.reserve_api_call) counts ALL agents' calls globally against a single per-endpoint limit. With N agents sharing the same endpoint limit of M calls/window, each agent effectively gets only M/N calls instead of M calls. For example, with 5 agents and a limit of 10 calls/60s, the global counter hits 10 after just 2 calls per agent, denying all subsequent requests. This explains the 64.6% denial rate (11,916 of 18,442 checks denied).
secondary_issues: Bus read amplification (7.5x) caused by in-memory-only offsets lost on restart
JSONL files grow unbounded with no TTL enforcement on disk
No compaction mechanism to reclaim space from expired messages

changes: New RateLimiter class with per-agent per-endpoint sliding window
SQLite-backed with BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions to prevent TOCTOU
Exponential backoff retry on SQLITE_BUSY (SOP-034 compliant)
Per-agent config overrides on top of default endpoint limits
Automatic pruning of expired call records (every 60s opportunistic)

before.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rate_limits WHERE api_endpoint = ? AND called_at > ?

after.denial_rate: 0% under normal per-agent quotas (each agent gets its own limit)
after.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rl_calls WHERE endpoint = ? AND agent_id = ? AND called_at > ?

files.bus.py: Updated BusReader with optional offset persistence

compactor_features: TTL-based message expiration (configurable default_ttl, per-message override)
Atomic compaction via os.replace() (write temp file, then atomic rename)
Read offset persistence in SQLite (per-agent per-channel byte offsets)
Automatic offset adjustment after compaction (readers at EOF -> new EOF, mid-file -> reset to 0)
Compaction stats logging to SQLite compaction_log table
compact_channel() for single channel, compact_all() for all .jsonl files
bus_reader_changes: Restores byte offset from SQLite on construction
Validates saved offset against current file size (handles compaction truncation)
Persists offset after each successful poll via _persist_offset()

before.read_amplification: 7.5x (full re-read of entire bus history on restart)
before.disk_growth: Unbounded at 318 bytes/message, no TTL enforcement on disk

after.disk_growth: Bounded by compaction interval (expired messages removed atomically)

tests_run: Per-agent rate limiting isolation (agent A quota independent of agent B)
Offset persistence eliminates re-reads across BusReader restarts
Bus compaction removes expired messages and shrinks file size
Backwards compatibility (BusReader works without offset store)

constraints_followed.SOP-034: Max 4 concurrent SQLite writers per DB - all writes use BEGIN IMMEDIATE with retry
constraints_followed.SOP-035: Before/after expectations documented in this results file
constraints_followed.backwards_compatible: BusReader new params are optional; old callers unchanged
constraints_followed.begin_immediate: All rate_limiter.py and compactor.py writes use BEGIN IMMEDIATE
constraints_followed.sqlite_busy_retry: Exponential backoff (0.1s doubling, 5 retries) on all write operations
